basic_details.job_title: IISER Berhampur PDRF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Berhampur (Office of the Dean, Faculty Affairs) has invited applications for one temporary PDRF position under Advertisement No. IISERBPR/ADV/PDRF/MATH/2026/04, with Dr. Prashanta Garain as Principal Investigator. Applications go by email to [email protected], with a copy to the PI, and must be sent by 2 December 2026, 12 PM.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed later to shortlisted candidates

qualification.details: Qualification and experience: candidates with PhD or those who have submitted PhD thesis under the above mentioned areas of research may apply. Research area: Analysis of Partial Differential Equations. Type of engagement: Temporary. Period of engagement: the tenure will be till 31st March 2027 from the date of joining. Principal Investigator: Dr. Prashanta Garain, Associate Professor ([email protected]). Project / funding agency: Institute Fund. | The notice prints no pay amount; the fellowship or remuneration is "As per Institute Norms (GoI)".

selection_process: The date of interview will be informed later to the shortlisted candidates through Email/phone. The interview will be conducted online via Google Meet.
important_instructions: Send the CV and Research Statement as separate PDF files, each below 10 MB. Copy the Principal Investigator on the application email. Write the subject line exactly as given in the notice. The engagement is temporary, and the tenure runs till 31st March 2027 from the date of joining. The notice gives these institute contacts: E-mail [email protected] / [email protected], Telephone 0680 222 7775/710.

content_sections.heading: About IISER Berhampur
content_sections.text: IISER Berhampur is an institute operating from its Transit Campus at Govt. ITI Premises, Engineering School Road, NH-59, Berhampur, District Ganjam, Odisha. This position is advertised by the Office of the Dean, Faculty Affairs and is funded from Institute Fund.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to [email protected] and copy the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . It must reach latest by 2 December 2026, 12 PM. Use this subject line: "Application for PDRF Position against advt. No. IISERBPR/ADV/PDRF/MATH/2026/04 dated 19/11/2026". The notice also asks candidates to arrange two recommendation letters to the same email address. Technical queries may be written to the same email ID.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience: candidates with PhD or those who have submitted PhD thesis under the above mentioned areas of research may apply. Research area: Analysis of Partial Differential Equations. Type of engagement: Temporary. Period of engagement: the tenure will be till 31st March 2027 from the date of joining. Principal Investigator: Dr. Prashanta Garain, Associate Professor ( [email protected] ). Project / funding agency: Institute Fund. The notice prints no pay amount; the fellowship or remuneration is "As per Institute Norms (GoI)".

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Detailed CV in PDF, below 10 MB. Research Statement in PDF, below 10 MB. Two recommendation letters, to be arranged to the email address [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The date of interview will be informed later to the shortlisted candidates through Email/phone. The interview will be conducted online via Google Meet.
